newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura shares hit new high for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Nomura shares hit new high for 1997.

text.p: Shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd hit a new high for this calendar year on Friday, as relieved investors returned to buy the shares after long-awaited administrative penalties for its role in a racketeer scandal were finally announced on Wednesday, traders said.
At 0147 GMT, the share price was up 60 yen at 1,740 yen, a new high for 1997, making the brokerage the fourth-largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

Brokers said bargain-hunting continued to lift the shares, as the penalties announced on Wednesday were within market expectations and market participants believed that all the negative factors related to the racketeer scandal were now out in the open.
